t: You're looking at the Cavalry of the Empire Memorial in Hyde Park, a war memorial to the service of cavalry regiments in the First and Second World Wars. It has been listed since 1987, and was upgraded to Grade II* in November 2014. Three people made it. The architect John James Burnet and the architect Thomas Tait designed it, and the sculptor Adrian Jones made it. Jones was an army vet for twenty-three years before becoming an artist, and that knowledge of horse anatomy shows in his work. He also made the sculpture on top of the Wellington Arch.
